name: Allostatic Anticipation

mechanism_chain.description: Environmental unpredictability detected (spatial, thermal, acoustic, or navigational signals)

data.finding: Uncontrollable, unpredictable noise is reliably more stressogenic than higher-level predictable noise
Environmental variability (thermal >1.5 SD, acoustic >10 dBA in 5-min window) triggers anticipatory physiological response

justification.backing: Glass & Singer's classic work established that uncontrollability and unpredictability are the critical stressors, not stimulus intensity. Sterling's allostasis framework formalizes this: the brain prepares for anticipated perturbations.
justification.qualifier: The unpredictability must exceed adaptation thresholds. Familiar unpredictability (known variability range) produces less anticipatory activation than novel unpredictability.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if occupants fully habituate to unpredictable environments; or if cognitive appraisal of safety overrides the physiological response.

mechanism_chain.ceiling_override_rationale: The mechanism or covariance evidence is well-supported and consistent across multiple studies. The confidence exceeds the default warrant ceiling due to replicability, multiple supporting pathways, and/or biological plausibility.

mechanism_chain.description: → Predictive model generates anticipatory prediction errors (PP: free-energy elevation)

data.finding: In active inference, environmental unpredictability generates accumulated free-energy (prediction error) even before discrete stressor occurs
data.effect: Anticipatory PE drives preparatory physiological state

data.finding: Anticipatory HPA activation precedes identifiable stressor by 2-10 minutes (modal 5 min)
data.effect: Substantially shorter lag than reactive 20-min onset

justification.backing: Friston's free-energy framework provides the computational account: uncertainty about future states elevates free energy, which must be resolved through action or physiological preparation. The anticipatory lag (5 min) is shorter than reactive onset (20 min) because the brain is preparing, not responding.
justification.qualifier: The anticipatory mechanism is well-grounded theoretically; direct architectural measurement of anticipatory cortisol (before identifiable stressor) is the critical empirical gap.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if anticipatory activation is purely cognitive (conscious worry) rather than embodied physiological preparation; or if the free-energy account does not map onto HPA dynamics.

mechanism_chain.description: → Interoceptive body-budget model updates: preparatory allostatic response (IC framework)

data.finding: Allostasis = predictive regulation; the body prepares metabolic and physiological states in anticipation of future demands
Interoceptive predictions are simultaneous with exteroceptive, not downstream; body-budget updates occur in real-time

justification.backing: Sterling's allostasis model and Seth's interoceptive inference framework converge: the body-budget (IC2 super-template) is continuously updated based on anticipated future demands, not just current state.
justification.qualifier: The IC2 mechanism is well-characterized theoretically; the specific parameters linking environmental unpredictability to body-budget predictions are model-derived rather than directly measured.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if body-budget updates are reactive rather than predictive; or if external environmental signals do not directly influence interoceptive predictions.

mechanism_chain.description: → Low-grade HPA and sympathetic activation without discrete stressor

data.finding: Anticipatory activations produce lower cortisol peaks than reactive activations; contribute 0.5 weight to allostatic load counter
Environments that are temporally unpredictable impose chronically elevated preparatory cost even when individual perturbations are modest

justification.backing: The bridge from anticipatory PE to low-grade HPA activation is capacity-level: we know the system CAN produce anticipatory activation, and we know unpredictable environments should trigger it, but direct measurement of anticipatory cortisol in architectural contexts is sparse.
justification.qualifier: Confidence is lower (0.55) because direct architectural measurement of anticipatory cortisol is the critical empirical gap identified by the panel.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if anticipatory HPA activation requires conscious awareness of threat; or if low-grade activation does not accumulate in the same way as discrete stressor activation.

mechanism_chain.ceiling_override_rationale: The mechanism or covariance evidence is well-supported and consistent across multiple studies. The confidence exceeds the default warrant ceiling due to replicability, multiple supporting pathways, and/or biological plausibility.

mechanism_chain.description: → If repeated without resolution: allostatic load accumulation (T6 chronic pathway)

data.finding: Mild-intensity repeated activations impose chronically elevated preparatory cost; 3-4 activations per day sustained over weeks produces measurable hippocampal effects
data.effect: Cumulative allostatic load from anticipatory activations

data.finding: Allostatic load threshold shared with T6: 4 activations/day standard; anticipatory count at 0.5 weight
data.effect: Anticipatory activations contribute to shared counter

justification.backing: T7 connects to T6's chronic pathway: anticipatory activations at half-weight still contribute to the allostatic load counter. Repeated anticipatory activation in unpredictable environments can exceed the 4/day threshold when weighted.
justification.qualifier: The 0.5 weighting is a panel consensus estimate based on anticipatory peaks being lower than reactive peaks. Direct validation is lacking.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if anticipatory activations do not contribute to cumulative glucocorticoid exposure in the same way as reactive activations; or if anticipatory activation resolves without cortisol elevation.

mechanism_chain.description: → Behavioral: vigilance, reduced exploration, shortened dwell time in unpredictable environments

data.finding: Perceived control over environmental conditions reduces anticipatory stress coupling; high control (AX4) multiplier 0.60, low control multiplier 1.40
Behavioral withdrawal from unpredictable environments is adaptive; shortened dwell time reduces cumulative exposure

justification.backing: The behavioral consequences of anticipatory stress are well-documented: vigilance (increased scanning), reduced exploration (conservative movement), and shortened dwell time (leaving unpredictable spaces). These are adaptive responses that minimize allostatic cost.
justification.qualifier: Behavioral responses vary with individual differences, task demands, and exit availability. Forced exposure (hospital bed, prison cell) prevents behavioral withdrawal, increasing physiological cost.
justification.rebuttal: Would fail if behavioral responses are primarily learned/cultural rather than physiologically driven; or if task engagement overrides vigilance responses.

prediction_error_signal.note: Anticipatory cortisol response precedes identifiable stressor; substantially shorter than reactive onset lag
prediction_error_signal.note_on_confidence: Anticipatory HPA activation mechanistically well-grounded but direct architectural measurement sparse

thermal.note: TC1 template; Adaptive Thermal Comfort occupant-adapted range

acoustic.note: 10 dBA variability within 5-minute window triggers anticipatory response; level secondary to variability

navigational.decision_uncertainty_threshold: 2+ consecutive navigation decisions with no confirming cues
navigational.note: Space Syntax intelligibility < 0.4 (normalized) corresponds to high navigational uncertainty; SS2 template

allostatic_load.note: Anticipatory activations contribute 0.5 units to the allostatic load counter (half-weight of full reactive activation). Justification: anticipatory activations produce lower cortisol peaks; McEwen model weights by magnitude × frequency.
allostatic_load.threshold_interaction: Shares T6 allostatic_load_threshold counter (4 activations/day); anticipatory count at 0.5 weight

privacy_gradient.description: Perceived control over environmental conditions reduces anticipatory stress coupling

high_control.note: Thermostat access, acoustic shielding, clear wayfinding — AX4 super-template

low_control.note: Forced exposure without agency — AX4 inverse

note_on_maturity: Mechanism well-grounded in PP and IC frameworks; direct architectural measurement of anticipatory cortisol is the critical empirical gap
ie_dpt_interaction: T_IE_005 (Cost-Gated Threshold) — anticipatory load reduces the explicit cognitive threshold for stress-triggered behavioral withdrawal from unpredictable spaces
key_references: Glass, D. C., & Singer, J. E. (1972). Urban stress. Academic Press.
panel_reasoning_excerpt:
## Summary of Panel-Recommended Template Revisions

| Template | Revision | Source |
|---|---|---|
| T1 (PP_SPECTRAL_MATCH) | Add prediction error LEVEL tag (low/intermediate/high hierarchy) | Friston |
| T2 (PP_COMPLEXITY_GOLDILOCKS) | Mechanism via precision × prediction error interaction, not PE alone; curve shifts with familiarity via prior precision | Friston |
| T3 (SN_LAYOUT_COGNITIVE_MAP) | Map is affective-spatial, not purely spatial; includes experiential binding | Nadel |
| T4 (DT_ATTENTIONAL_DEMAND) | Specify DMN subsystems (MTL vs. dmPFC); DMN is not "rest" but active model maintenance | Raichle |
| T5 (NM_THREAT_HPA) | Split ACh pathway from general threat; add cholinergic specificity and temporal dynamics | Chiba |
| T6 (NM_CORTISOL_HIPPOCAMPAL) | Add temporal distinction: acute (enhances) vs. chronic (impairs) hippocampal function | Nadel |
| T7 (IC_ALLOSTATIC_ANTICIPATION) | Elevate to master-template status; rename to ALLOSTATIC_EFFICIENCY | Seth, Sterling |
| T8 (EC_AFFORDANCE_POSTURAL) | Broaden from postural to full sensorimotor; movement IS cognition, not input to it | Clark |
| T12 (IC_INTEROCEPTIVE_AFFECT) | Fix serial pipeline error: interoceptive predictions are simultaneous with exteroceptive, not downstream | Seth |

cross_template_interactions.IC2: Body Budget Prediction — primary mechanism; anticipatory allostasis is IC2 operating forward in time
cross_template_interactions.AX4: Perceived Control — primary modifier; controllability_modifier parameters are AX4 operationalizations

higher_order_principle: Environmental unpredictability → behavioral vigilance pathway: The mechanism by which allostatic anticipation operates
